prompt:

Repaint image 1 into clean high-definition hand-painted game art that fits restrained Skurfa-style HD backgrounds. Description: Lohan cut147 slot1 yellow woven architectural/decorative surface above and around a rounded dark inset. Preserve the nearly rectangular bright upper woven band and broad dark arch beneath it, including the rounded inset near the lower center. Restore dense fine crossing straw/cane weave with source-light yellow and olive-brown shading. Do not replace this weave with large black beams or angular timber panels. Do not invent doors, handles, lettering, a basket or foliage. Strict framing: exactly 42:28 canvas aspect, same object positions, source silhouette, internal openings, overlapping planes and negative space. Fill the same visible footprint, without widening or centering the object, adding padding, rotating it or cropping a new composition. Refine continuous material detail; do not reproduce a coarse pixel mosaic. Do not invent any objects or alter scene lighting. Output on real transparency with no backdrop. No border, text, logo, comparison board or full-scene output. Produce exactly one finished texture.

The lower broad dark rounded inset is a flatter source-shaped oval/arch extending to the bottom, not a new hanging basket. Keep its source-positioned shading and curved sides. NO thick vertical bamboo poles, NO three posts, NO large dark X-braces, NO new horizontal beams, NO binding knots or invented framework. Restore all original occupied pixels and their color masses, including sides of the dark inset. Keep continuous fine woven texture and warm dim source lighting, improving resolution without a pixel mosaic. No lettering, handles, flowers or new doors. One exact-framed HD texture on real transparency where the source has empty space.
